title: Affiliate links, attribution và payouts
scope_items: Database Migration 00031: Created affiliate_links, creator_assignments, affiliate_attributions, affiliate_commissions, affiliate_payouts, affiliate_statements, affiliate_statement_items, link_health_records tables with composite tenant keys (uq_*_tenant_pk), strict tenant RLS isolation (ENABLE + FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), check constraints, and narrow role-based grants.

Acceptance Target 1 (Creator income distinct from seller expense): When workspace economic role is creator, affiliate commission earned is recognized as income/revenue; seller COGS is never deducted. When role is seller, affiliate commission paid is recorded as an expense deduction from gross profit.

Acceptance Target 2 (Ambiguous attribution labeled): Multi-touch conversions (direct visit after click or cross-device) are explicitly labeled with source_class = 'inferred' and confidence = 'medium' (or 'low' for >=3 touches) with explanatory note ('Multiple touch points detected — last click rule applied.'). Single connected platform click is source_class = 'official' with high confidence.

Acceptance Target 3 (Broken link repair): Health monitor flags broken/out-of-stock links with link_status = 'broken', calculates estimated_revenue_impact, suggests replacement products, and emits affiliate.link_health.broken. The repair workflow updates the destination URL and replacement product, safely restoring healthy status while strictly barring reactivation of permanently revoked links.
Creator Assignments & Link Generation: Creator assignments generate unique referral codes and tracking URLs, supporting campaign associations, tracking cookies, and commission tier overrides.

Statement Import, Commission Reconciliation & Clawbacks: External affiliate statements can be imported, matched with internal attributions, reconciled, and clawbacks handled with reversible negative ledger entries upon order cancellation or return.
Payout Batches with Cryptographic Proof: Approved commission balances are bundled into payout batches generating SHA-256 disbursement proofs before settling in the operating ledger.
verified_sub_slices: Acceptance Target 1 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget1_CreatorIncomeDistinctFromSellerExpense (Go -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter test suite confirm creator commission is recognized as income without COGS deduction, while seller commission is recorded as an expense deduction.

Acceptance Target 2 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget2_AmbiguousAttributionLabeled (Go -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter test suite confirm multi-touch conversions are labeled as inferred with medium/low confidence and explanation note.

Acceptance Target 3 Verified: TestAcceptanceTarget3_BrokenLinkRepair (Go -race), Vitest web test suite, and Flutter test suite confirm broken link repair restores healthy status while permanently revoked links are strictly barred from repair.

Creator Assignments, Statements, Clawbacks & Payouts Verified: TestCreatorAssignmentsAndCoupons, TestAffiliateStatementImportAndReconciliation, TestPayoutBatchAndProofGeneration, TestCommissionClawbackFlow, and TestAffiliateConnectRPCHandlers pass cleanly with Go race detector.
Migration 00031 Verified: Migrator test suite (migrator_test.go) passes all 31 migrations up, status verification, and clean down transactional reversal.

Proto Codegen & Static Invariants Verified: Buf lint passes with 0 errors; TypeScript shared types compile cleanly; Dart analyze passes with 0 issues; check_d0 static documentation invariant gate passes.

Web & Mobile Surfaces Verified: Vitest web test suite (8 tests passing), svelte-check (0 errors, 0 warnings), Vite production build (adapter-node ✔ done), and Flutter test suite (4 tests passing, flutter analyze 0 issues) all pass.
external_gates: Migration 00031 schema, composite foreign keys, RLS policies (FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY), and narrow grants verified via dry-run and local migrator test; live multi-tenant PostgreSQL RLS suite runs in CI harness.

External network statement imports (Shopee, TikTok Shop, Amazon Associates) require production API credentials and live webhook endpoints; statement ingestion and manual reconciliation verified locally.
Disbursement batches generate cryptographic SHA-256 proof locally; automated wire/ACH payouts via banking partners require licensed banking rails in production.
